metric: Hours a week the owner and his staff spend on the workflow he ranks first, from his account of the last 2 weeks; whether he names that workflow before we suggest any.

decision: pending. Persevere: run a concierge MVP on that workflow with his examples. Pivot: test his next-ranked pain, or stop if no workflow clears the threshold.
